# actiself

> actiself is a prevention app for iPhone and wearables by Biomentric UG (Munich, Germany), developed by researchers of the Max Planck Institute of Psychiatry. A 6-week programme with 42 evidence-based exercises from behavioural therapy (stress management, behavioural activation, everyday physical activity, sleep hygiene) for working people under chronic stress. The app is currently available in German only; English and French versions are planned for early 2027.

## Key facts
- Platforms: iOS and watchOS; works with wearables that sync with Apple Health
- Activation code: https://actiself.store/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/actiself/id6737044573
- Study: https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.01.18.25320669v1 (pilot study, 52 participants)
- Support: support@biomentric.zohodesk.eu
- Not a medical treatment and no substitute for one
